searchChecks: Missing/corrupt runtime, incomplete coverage, and stale indexed content all fail validation.
Chromium: exact page coverage and metadata, both languages, full-text results, highlights, URL/history, focus, 320/390/1440px reflow, and rendered axe/contrast checks.
Network failure gives a readable error and retry succeeds; no-JavaScript visitors retain bilingual browsing links.
A larger disposable archive returns 10 results at a time, loads the remaining results, and maintains keyboard focus in both languages.

Disposable rebuilds prove indexing/integrity failures stop publication, newly published articles and edits become searchable, renamed URLs disappear, drafts stay excluded, and unpublishing removes content in both languages.
limitations: Automated Chromium and axe checks do not substitute for actual VoiceOver/NVDA usability testing.
